scope: Independent second pass: exact titles, spelling, punctuation, hyphens, author order, venues, years, pages, identifiers, and versions for eight assigned bibliography keys. Sources freshly requested; title-page PDFs freshly downloaded and visually inspected. No repository edits.
method: Publisher/arXiv landing records and original PDF title pages; fresh ACM-deposited Crossref JSON for three ACM publications. Title capitalization imposed by a bibliography style is separated from missing or altered wording. Local mid-*-titlepage.png files preserve inspected renderings.

source_metadata_discrepancies: VALG26: arXiv landing metadata omits the subtitle visibly present on the version-2 PDF title page; retain the PDF title with provenance documented.
summary.other_findings: KMS20's proceedings pagination is 2236-2262, even though its PDF uses article-local 1-27. BHHLT26's PDF displays April 2026, while arXiv v1 submission was 16 June 2026. These do not invalidate the cited years or version dates.
